reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), asset() returned canonical USDx 0xa1fa7777974312f7d801a8880714a218f76233f8. totalAssets() was 36,018,311.186761451471271827 USDx; totalSupply() was 34,697,103.474753935170938607 shares; exchangeRate() was 1.038078328727608177 USDx per share. getVaultState() and USDx.balanceOf(vault) agreed on assetBalance=requiredAssets=45,534,526.553486274453968047 USDx, with solvent=true. Pending liabilities were 9,494,452.838503114589099543 USDx, claimable liabilities 539.148592078763963117 USDx and unvested rewards 21,223.379629629629633560 USDx. These three buckets are excluded from active-share totalAssets. The direct wrapper dependency is 100% USDx; accounting solvency is not independent financial assurance of the parent's offchain portfolio.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact single-asset ERC-4626/ERC-7540 claim confirmed by asset() and published vault accounting; active shares are backed by USDx principal and vested rewards.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified direct wrapper asset is asserted. All underlying portfolio, hedge, custody and legal uncertainty remains on usdx-axis; asynchronous servicing and upgrade risk are local wrapper exposures. The seven-day cooldown establishes request eligibility only; REDEMPTION_SERVICER_ROLE must make the request claimable. Terms clause 5.3 guarantees no processing timeframe, and clause 6 permits variable service fees. No finite realization horizon is established, so liquidityHorizon remains unknown. At the fresh October 15 checkpoint requests, servicing and claims were unpaused but pending-request cancellation was paused; neither the active assets nor liability reserves establish completion capacity for new requests.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The direct USDx claim and its pending, claimable and unvested buckets are held in the canonical onchain V2 vault; there is no separate silo or local lending strategy in the verified implementation. Whole-book custody stays unknown, matching usdx-axis: the wrapper's own claim is onchain, but the USDx backing materially depends on centralized venues and other offchain positions whose aggregate custody tier is unestablished. No named-provider allocation, enforceable holder segregation, insolvency priority or independent financial assurance is inferred. Parent docs state no off-exchange custody, while the capital-location dashboard assigns a qualified-custody category; the exact provider and legal safeguards remain unresolved upstream. The vault is upgradeable, restrictable and permissioned for queue servicing.
